name: Calcium Channel Blockers (Dihydropyridine)
note: Avoid combining two dihydropyridine CCBs due to severe peripheral edema and hypotension risk

name: Angiotensin II Receptor Blockers (ARBs)
note: Avoid dual ARB therapy or combining with ACE inhibitors due to hyperkalemia and renal failure risk

name: ACE Inhibitors
note: Avoid combining with ARBs or direct renin inhibitors

name: Beta-Blockers
note: Avoid combining two non-vasodilating beta blockers

name: NSAIDs
note: Avoid concurrent use of multiple systemic NSAIDs due to GI ulceration risk
